label: Scope of "not all overdetermined"
resolution: The sentence admits a per-cause and a collective reading, and each has its own claim and statement. Per-cause yields PhysicalistFork with the other premises (physicalistFork). Collective yields only SomeBased (someBased), and collectiveHybrid satisfies it with an unbased occurrence. No argument here uses the collective reading for a universal conclusion or passes from one reading to the other. The distributive reading implies the collective one only given an occurrence with a physical effect; no theorem here states that implication.
